Any changes to the programme of study originally agreed must be documented in an updated “Learning Agreement for Studies”. Incoming students must take a minimum of 15 ECTS per exchange semester. Students must be residents in the country of the host university during their study. The minimum duration of a student mobility for studies is three months.
